name: Civfund
fix_description: Function 0x5ffe72b7 only checks !paused() but has no access control. Anyone can call it to make the contract mint Uniswap V3 liquidity positions with attacker-controlled parameters (tick range, amounts). Attacker provides liquidity at an unfavorable range then swaps against it. Fix by adding onlyOwner or authorized-caller check.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: flash-loan BUSD, swap into UN, abuse the pair via repeated token transfers plus skim calls to distort balances/reserves, then swap back for profit and repay. It requires understanding Uniswap V2 pair accounting and skim behavior rather than just spotting a simple access-control bug, but the PoC is still relatively compact and self-contained.
